rv.q: This isn't just triumphant, it's transcendent.
Dominic Cooke responds with an outstanding revival — spectacular, sassy, sorrowful and ultimately deeply sad.
Tracie Bennett's rendition of I'm Still Here justifies on its own the price of a ticket.
Every aspect of this production is lavish and flawless: the acting is sublime, each character is full and resonates with truth...
All things considered, this is an impressive production, tremendous, thrilling and truly terrific.
Cooke's production blossoms into a rich, melancholic meditation on life and old times.
